title: Autopay Discount on the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Refinance APR
content:
A balloon refinance of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract carries an autopay discount on the refinance APR, based on the balloon payments posted through the autopay ACH channel in the 12 calendar months ending on the refinance date:

| Autopay payments posted in the 12 months | Reduction of the refinance APR |
|---|---|
| At least 10 | 0.25 percentage points |
| At least 6 but fewer than 10 | 0.1 percentage points |
| Fewer than 6 | None |

Payments through other channels are not counted. A window of 12 calendar months ending on the refinance date takes in the dates on or before the refinance date that fall fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it.
